name.en: Beige Marble-Look Porcelain Wall Tile, Large Format for Fewer Visible Joints, Sold in Two Project Packs

description.en: A coordinated wall covering for kitchens, bathrooms and feature walls. The listed format helps plan cuts, while the finish is easy to combine with grout and trim. This listing is for beige marble-look porcelain wall tile, large format for fewer visible joints.
description.pt-BR: Um revestimento coordenado para cozinhas, banheiros e paredes de destaque. O formato indicado ajuda a planejar os recortes e combina com rejunte e acabamento. Este anúncio apresenta porcelanato de parede com visual de mármore bege, formato grande para menos juntas visíveis.
